title: A chart's filter choice is still set on your next visit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians and at least two service advisors have invoiced work with clocked time this month in this location.
  5. You use the same browser throughout (the choice is kept in this browser only).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Technician Efficiency (This Month) > View details > Technician filter lists at least two names, and Billing Efficiency (This Month) > View details > Advisor filter lists at least two names. If not, create the data: with Tech ShopView and your own name as Service Advisor: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Then create a second technician you can sign in as: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, and repeat with a second customer, that technician and a different Service Advisor.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. In the Technician filter keep only one technician ticked (any one in the list).
  4. On the Billing Efficiency tile, click View details.
  5. In the Advisor filter choose one advisor (any advisor in the list).
  6. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  7. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  8. Open the Technician Efficiency detail and read its filter.
  9. Open the Billing Efficiency detail and read its filter.
  10. Read the Technician Utilization filter (open its detail).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Technician Efficiency chart still shows only the technician you kept.
  • The Billing Efficiency chart still shows only the advisor you chose.
  • The Technician Utilization chart is unaffected and still shows all technicians, because each tile keeps its own choice.
